the DC component of the earth current and its effect on the power transformer.
the effects of DC component in the power system to power transformer.
the DC-bias current and the power transformer, and the effects of DC current on the transformer are analyzed.

the power transformer is very sensitive to the DC component in earth current.

the DC-bias is harmful to the power transformer.

the DC component of earth current is the most important reason to cause the transformer to fail, which is a great threat to the power system security.
the power transformer should be designed with the ability of enduring DC-bias current, and the DC component in earth is a very important factor to be considered in the design of power transformer.
, the DC component in transformer winding is the main cause for the transformer failure, and that the transformer should be designed with the consideration of the DC-bias in the earth current.
